_note: The beat runner's script (cine/beats.gd, design/typical-day.md section 2). A sequence is an ordered list of beats. A beat starts by running `do`, giving PIP its `pip` order and emitting its `line` (an id the HUD looks up: the words are written at the event), then waits; when `wait` is met (or after `max_s`) it emits beat_done(id) and the next beat starts, or the one named in `then` ("end" stops the sequence). wait: {time: s} | {place: {at, r}} (the hero within r m of a spot) | {action: name} | {event: name}; actions and events both arrive through notify(name): jump and look (the view turned look_deg) are watched by the runner, lift and use:<what> come from the interactions, pip_arrived from PIP, chose:<id> from the rules. pip: go_to (drive and park; wave and point_at then happen on arrival), follow_me (lead there, waiting while the hero is more than lead_wait_m behind, going on within lead_resume_m), point_at (stop and look), wave. do: clock:dawn (jump the look to dawn and pin it), clock:run (let it run), clock:skip (the time-lapse to the next phase), open:<item> (open its door), hero:<start> (put the hero at a `starts` row), ghost:on|off (the Earth jump beside the hero), offer:<choice id> (choice_offered; the rules own it). A spot is [x, z], a PIP stop id (world.json pip.stops), a landmark, an item id, `pip` or `hero`; a look point is [x, z, height], a stop id (its look), an item id or `hero`. All numbers here are art direction

ghost._note: the faint hero beside the real one doing the same hop on Earth (cine/beats_ghost.gd): color a DESIGN.md token, alpha its opacity, side_m to the hero's right, linger_s shown after it lands (the hero is still in the air for about 0.4 s of it)

airlock._note: inside HAB 1, at its door, facing out (item space; the model's door is on its -Z front)
